# Tissue PBR software fixture

`software-material.tissue-pbr.json` contains seven valid 16×16 PNG images generated using Python standard-library zlib and PNG CRC32 chunks. Substrate pixels are sRGB (164, 54, 48), normals are (128, 128, 255), roughness is 128, and colour-layer alpha is zero. The wet layer alpha is 255 while recipe wetness is zero.

This is an explicitly labelled software test fixture, not a generated neural material, surgical reference, training result, or realism evidence. The executed flag refers only to execution of the deterministic fixture generator. The seed is the full unsigned 64-bit maximum.
